issues.summary: Hanseatic Marine Lines invoiced USD 900 detention for container HMLU6066254 (40HC), MBL HMLU260592, as the empty was returned 6 days after the 7-day free time (2 days typhoon terminal closure, 4 days Rapid Haul dispatch backlog).
The USD 900 detention case for HMLU6066254 was not escalated to the Import Team Lead within 48 hours and was only discovered via the May KPI report.

decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided to dispute the 2 typhoon terminal-closure days of the USD 900 detention for HMLU6066254 with Hanseatic Marine Lines and bill Rapid Haul Logistics for the other 4 days caused by their dispatch backlog.
Jiwoo Han handed over the carrier detention dispute for HMLU6066254 to Daniel Cho ahead of her departure on 30 June.
Jiwoo Han handed over the trucker billing (4 days detention debit note to Rapid Haul Logistics) for HMLU6066254 to Junho Oh.

tasks.summary: Follow up with Hanseatic D&D desk (Marcus Keller) on the detention dispute for the 2 terminal-closure days on container HMLU6066254, MBL HMLU260592.
Issue a debit note to Rapid Haul Logistics for 4 days detention on container HMLU6066254 out of the USD 900 invoice.

deadlines.what: Follow-up with Hanseatic on detention dispute for 2 terminal-closure days on HMLU6066254
Debit note to Rapid Haul Logistics for 4 days detention on HMLU6066254
